name: Kilji escape pod
description: A type of escape pod was found aboard the Kilji Illumine government war cruiser Anvil. Small and made of metal, they were equipped with a viewport, thrusters, and an automatic beacon that broadcast its location after they were jettisoned. A passenger aboard a Kilji escape pod could survive for hours before running out of oxygen. Two pods were located aboard Illumine General Crofyp's Anvil, one to the bridge's portside, covered by an orange-rimmed door, and the other to starboard.
